item_name: Badge Magic Adhesive Cut To Fit Freestyle Kit
item_short_desc: The Badge Magic Cut-to-Fit Kit contains over 100 square inches of adhesive that can be cut to any shape so you can easily attach patches to your uniform.
description: With thousands of uses, this Badge Magic Adhesive Cut To Fit Freestyle Kit is an essential to keep around your home, office or in your vehicle! Use this adhesive kit to attach patches to uniforms or costumes, to hem clothing, repair holes in fabric, or attach your shoe sole insoles. Trace and cut the patch adhesive to any size and shape you need it, then peel and stick the adhesive sheet to attach two pieces of fabric without the need for sewing. The adhesive is machine washable, withholding 50 or more wash and dry cycles while staying secure. This peel and stick patch attachment can be removed to re-position projects as needed using common household solvents or dry cleaning. This emergency sewing repair kit measures 8.5 Inches x 12 Inches.
